media.title: Fats Waller at the piano, 1938
media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of Fats Waller seated at a piano.
media.publicCaption: Fats Waller at the piano in 1938. Waller co-wrote “Ain’t Misbehavin’,” transcribed by Kaper as Jazz Drops no. 2.
media.publicCreditLine: Alan Fisher; New York World-Telegram and the Sun Newspaper Photograph Collection, Library of Congress; via Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. The Library of Congress reports no known restrictions for the New York World-Telegram and Sun staff-photograph collection; this staff photograph forms part of the collection placed in the public domain under its deed of gift.
